method: UnityPy: load resources.assets + globalgamemanagers.assets; resolve each GameObject's MonoBehaviour m_Script PPtr to its MonoScript class name; item prefabs are GameObjects with an 'Item' component (id = first serialized field of Item), containers are GameObjects with a 'Container' component whose body (maxWeight, maxWeightPerItem, encumberanceMult, itemsVisible, tagRestriction) is decoded from the raw bytes because this build ships no MonoBehaviour type trees; each decoded body is accepted only if its computed byte length equals the object's real length
notInAssetsNote: resources.assets holds 429 GameObject instances carrying an Item component in 338 distinct GameObject names, but only 301 distinct Item.id values: 128 names are editor duplicates of the form '<id> (N)' that keep the same Item.id, so the prefab list maps 1:1 onto the item table. Every one of the 300 GlobalItems ids has at least one prefab (0 ids without a prefab), and the only prefab id absent from the table is 'reinforcedrope', which no decompiled code references (grep over work/decompile: 0 hits), i.e. an unreachable leftover prefab. So the prefab list corroborates the id table (no id lacks a prefab) but cannot by itself prove completeness: it contains real prefabs that are not in the table, and prefab counts are inflated by duplicates.
